content:
alice: Heads up — starting 1923456700 we saw a flurry of GPU provisioning failures in ap-southeast-1. VM boots complete but instances hang in PROVISIONING. Noticed a KMS DENY in the node bootstrap logs and our audit entries for some IAM role-assume events are missing. Can infra/security triage?

ben: Ack. Which KMS key/policy was changed and when?

alice: Looks like a small policy tweak pushed at 1923456600 to tighten cross-account usage. Change set snippet from the deploy logs: `Principal: arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-provisioner`, `Condition: StringEquals: aws:SourceVpc = vpc-0abc1234` — suspect private link endpoints are hitting a mismatch.

carol: Also seeing lots of NAT gateway retry spikes -> conntrack saturation on the proxy fleet. Packets get dropped during image fetches which delays instance bootstrap -> provisioning state.

dan: On the audit logs: are we missing CloudTrail events or are they delayed? `sec-bot`?

sec-bot: System: CloudTrail delivery shows `S3:PutObject` success for most regions, but ap-southeast-1 had ~12 minutes of write failures to the audit bucket around 1923456605-1923457325. Root cause flagged: transient IAM Deny on KMS decrypt used by the delivery process.

alice: So two linked issues: KMS policy tighten caused both node bootstrap decrypts to fail (provisioning) and also the CloudTrail delivery to fail (missing audit events). The NAT/proxy conntrack saturation exacerbates bootstrap delays.

ben: Immediate mitigation options?

carol: For infra we can: 1) temporarily revert the policy to allow the provisioner role (fast), 2) scale proxy fleet and increase conntrack max on the proxies (medium), 3) fallback to regional Dedicated pool in us-east-1 for critical jobs (slow but safe).

alice: I pushed a revert to the KMS policy in a quick rollback at 1923456750 and opened a canary job. Can everyone check if PROVISIONING counts drop?

infra-bot: Alert: GPU provisioning error rate in ap-southeast-1 decreased from 12% -> 3% in the last 3m after policy rollback.

carol: Good signal. I'm still seeing some delayed image pulls. Increasing proxy ASG desired to +30% and bumping conntrack_max on the proxy AMI: `/proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max` from 262144 -> 524288. Rolling now.

dan: Cost heads-up — scaling proxies and using cross-region fallbacks will add ~20-30% short-term network/GPU cost for the cluster. We should track spend to a temp tag.

ben: Security note: we need a safer deployment pattern for KMS policy changes. Proposal: staged policy rollout + automated smoke that tries an ephemeral node bootstrap via private link and validates CloudTrail S3 writes before full rollout.

alice: +1. Also we should increase CloudTrail sampling for S3 PutObject auditing for key infra buckets during policy change windows so we can detect delivery failures faster.

carol: Ops checklist I'm doing: `1) confirm provisioning backlog drained; 2) finish proxy conntrack bump; 3) re-run canary bootstrap; 4) enable flow logs on affected subnets` — ETA 20m.

infra-bot: Deployment note: conntrack bump rolled to 4/5 proxies, remaining 1 rolling.

sec-bot: Post-incident recommended actions (initial): `- Add preflight bootstrap smoke for KMS policy PRs; - Add automated CloudTrail integrity checks + alert on PutObject failures; - Add policy guardrail to prevent overly restrictive SourceVpc condition without explicit private-link mapping; - Run quota test for conntrack under image-pull workloads`.

ben: I'll own the policy guardrail RFC. Assigning to @ben and @alice to co-author.

dan: I'll add a temporary cost tag `incident/1923456789` to all scaled proxies and cross-region ingest traffic so finance can track.

alice: Update: canary bootstraps succeeded, provisioning rates back to baseline. Leaving this thread open for the follow-ups Ben/Dan/Carol. Thanks all :thumbsup:

carol: logging the conntrack change and flow log enablement in the runbook now: `runbooks/provisioning/1923456789-conntrack-audit.md` (internal).

infra-bot: Thread closed for new autoscaling events: none in last 15m.
